title: Fatal Beauty
description: A drug called "Fatal Beauty" has hit the streets of Los Angeles, and tough cop Rita Rizzoli is out to take down the drug lord responsible!

title: Foxy Brown
description: Foxy Brown (Pam Grier) vows vengeance against those responsible for the death of an undercover officer.

title: Sheba, Baby
description: Pam Grier plays Sheba Shayne, a private eye who is called back to her hometown to stop the local mob boss from moving in on her father's loan business.

title: Friday Foster
description: A photojournalist Friday Foster (Pam Grier) witnesses the attempted assassination of a prominent African-American figure. Now she is a target!

title: Across 110th Street
description: When Harlem gangsters mess with the Mafia, an unlikely pair of New York's finest must work together to bring justice to the streets!

title: Hammer
description: A boxer on-the-rise is asked to throw a fight by the local mob that has figured prominently in his success.

title: Diggstown
description: James Woods and Louis Gossett, Jr. are a potent one-two punch as a con man and an over-the-hill boxer out to scam Bruce Dern out of a small fortune!

title: Ronin
description: Robert De Niro, Jean Reno and Stellan Skarsgard headline a stellar cast in director John Frankenheimer's action-packed and intelligent spy thriller about a group of for-hire mercenaries out to steal a top-secret briefcase for a mysterious client.

title: Thief
description: Michael Mann ("Manhunter") directs this stylish, action-packed drama that stars James Caan ("Misery") as a master safe cracker who is planning his last heist for the sake of a woman, Tuesday Weld ("Who'll Stop The Rain?"), and a new life.

title: Into the Blue
description: Paul Walker and Jessica Alba heat up the screen as two divers who dream of finding hidden treasure.

title: Dark Blue
description: When the LAPD's elite Special Investigations Squad (SIS) is assigned a high-profile quadruple homicide, veteran detective Eldon Perry (Kurt Russell) takes the case. Known for his tough street tactics and a fiery temper, Eldon also tutors rookie Bobby Keough (Scott Speedman) in the grim realities of police intimidation and corruption.  While navigating the tumultuous neighborhoods of South Central L.A., Perry and Keough must track down the cold-blooded killers as well as face their own demons - demons that prove more ruthless than the criminals they pursue.

title: State Of Grace
description: An undercover cop (Sean Penn) comes back to his old neighborhood in Hell's Kitchen to bring down the Irish Mafia.

title: Fled
description: Two prison escapees on the lam race against time to find a hidden cache of cash and an incriminating computer disk.

title: Hoodlum
description: In New York of the 1920s, three rival gang leaders (Laurence Fishhburne, Tim Roth and Andy Garcia) battle for control of Harlem's urban power.

title: Black Caesar
description: Tommy Gibbs (Fred Williamson) grows up to become the reigning head of Harlem's black mafia.

title: Bucktown
description: Fred Williamson and Pam Grier star in this tense action drama about a man who comes to Bucktown to bury his slain brother.

title: Cotton Comes To Harlem
description: Two detectives find themselves on a wild goose chase for stolen cash that takes them from the Apollo Theater through the heart and soul of Harlem!

title: Slaughter
description: An ex-Vietnam, ex-Green Beret captain (Jim Brown) is out to avenge the murder of his parents by the psychotic Dominic Hoffo (Rip Torn).

title: Original Gangstas
description: Action legends return to the genre that made them famous in this big, brassy and action-packed tale!

title: Harley Davidson And The Marlboro Man
description: Mickey Rourke and Don Johnson star in this four-lane genre collision of biker movie, heist thriller, buddy flick and sci-fi pic that will take you to the hardline of action and adventure! Co-starring Tom Sizemore, Chelsea Field and Vanessa Williams.

title: Navy Seals
description: Charlie Sheen, Michael Biehn and Bill Paxton are three of America's finest Navy commandos. Sent to rescue the crew of a U.S. aircraft carrying Stinger missiles seized by Mideast terrorists, they're thrust onto the frontline of an explosive conflict!

title: Missing In Action
description: American servicemen are still being held captive in Vietnam – and it's up to one man to bring them home in this blistering, fast-paced action/adventure starring martial arts superstar Chuck Norris.

title: Missing In Action 2: The Beginning
description: Chuck Norris returns as James Braddock in this action-packed prequel to the original hit film. As war rages in Vietnam, Braddock and his men are captured and imprisoned. With fists and sheer courage, he must become an army of one to save his men.

title: Braddock: Missing In Action III
description: When Colonel James Braddock (Chuck Norris, "Missing in Action") is told that his wife and 12-year-old son are still alive in Communist Vietnam, he mounts a one-man assault to free them…armed with the latest high-tech firepower, of course!

title: 10 To Midnight
description: Charles Bronson is Leo Kessler, a cynical cop on the trail of Warren Stacy (Gene Davis), a homicidal maniac. When the legal system sets Stacy free, Kessler has one option: to hunt down Stacy on his own before the crazed killer can strike again!

title: Kinjite: Forbidden Subjects
description: Action superstar Charles Bronson is at his two-fisted best in this gritty thriller about a hardnosed vice cop who is hellbent on wiping out a child prostitution ring after an assault on his young daughter; taking vengeance into his own hands!

title: Murphy's Law
description: Charles Bronson stars as an LAPD cop framed for murder by Joan Freeman, a vicious ex-con he had put in prison. Going on the run and handcuffed to a foul-mouthed petty thief, he attempts to track down Freeman even as she keeps killing his associates.

title: Messenger Of Death
description: Charles Bronson travels to a Colorado to investigate and finds a plot of greed and religious zealotry.

title: The Mechanic
description: In this nail-biting action film, when an aging hitman (Charles Bronson) takes on an eager apprentice (Jan-Michael Vincent) they become an unmatchable team of killers...until the pupil's ruthlessness puts the two on a deadly collision course!

title: Mr. Majestyk
description: Cinema tough guy Charles Bronson stars as Majestyk, an ex-con and Vietnam vet, whose efforts to run a farm are thwarted by narrow-minded locals and corrupt cops. But when a Mafia hitman destroys his crop, the farmer's fuse is finally blown.

title: American Ninja
description: Michael Dudikoff stars as Joe Armstrong, a one-man fighting machine. Serving in the army to avoid prison, Joe finds himself battling the deadly Black Star Order, as well as corrupt military leaders in order to bring down an illegal arms sale.

title: American Ninja 2: The Confrontation
description: In this action-packed sequel, Joe Armstrong and Curtis Jackson are sent to the Caribbean in search of missing Marines. But they must first battle scientifically engineered Super Ninjas to bring down a dreaded drug lord known as The Lion!

title: American Ninja 3: Blood Hunt
description: Martial artist David Bradley takes the reins as Sean Davidson in this third installment of the wildly popular "American Ninja" franchise, teaming up with Steve James to battle a maniacal terrorist in yet another explosive action-packed adventure!

title: American Ninja 4: The Annihilation
description: Michael Dudikoff is back in action in this thrilling sequel! Teamed up with CIA operative Sean Davidson (David Bradley), Joe Armstrong (Dudikoff) returns to help foil the plans of a terrorist (James Booth) hell-bent on annihilating New York City.

title: Enter The Ninja
description: When Cole (Franco Nero), a westerner trained in the deadly fighting rituals of Ninjitsu, is suddenly dragged into a dangerous dispute with an oil baron, he must face the best assassin money can buy, Ninja Hasegawa (martial arts legend Sho Kosugi)!

title: Revenge Of The Ninja
description: When a band of Ninja assassins slaughters the family of Cho Osaki (Sho Kosugi), he flees to America in the hope of building a new life. Osaki tries to escape his deadly past but soon discovers he has become the pawn of a ruthless drug trafficker.

title: Ninja III: The Domination
description: Possessed by the spirit of a diabolical Ninja assassin and dominated by his relentless rage, a young, attractive woman sets out to brutally attack and destroy his enemies. Can her boyfriend and a martial arts master possibly save her soul?

title: Lone Wolf Mcquade
description: Chuck Norris is Lone Wolf McQuade, a Texas Ranger feared by outlaws and respected by other lawmen. When McQuade uncovers a gun smuggling operation, the action explodes, with McQuade wreaking havoc on all those who come between him and the law.

title: Code Of Silence
description: Chuck Norris stars in this turbo-charged thriller that pits an honest cop against two crime lords and his own department. Henry Silva and Dennis Farina also star in a film that explodes with heart-stopping chases and martial arts confrontations.

title: Invasion U.S.A.
description: An army of terrorist mercenaries led by Soviet agent Rostov (Richard Lynch) catches America unprepared and makes it into a war zone. Only one man can stem the rising tide of violence: retired agent and martial arts expert Matt Hunter (Chuck Norris).

title: Hero And The Terror
description: A murderer (Jack O'Halloran) escapes from an institution, determined to destroy the cop who sent him away, Chuck Norris. Norris must anticipate "The Terror's" next move, knowing deep down he will have to face this homicidal beast alone.

title: Firewalker
description: Two hapless soldiers of misfortune (Chuck Norris, Louis Gossett Jr.) meet a beautiful girl (Melody Anderson) with a map to a lost gold mine and decide to have one last shot at striking it rich. But the trail to the treasure is no yellow brick road!

title: Good Guys Wear Black
description: Action superstar Chuck Norris stars as John T. Booker, the former leader of an elite commando unit who must uncover the reason why his former squad members are being systematically murdered one by one. Anne Archer and James Franciscus co-star.

title: Gang Related
description: Tupac Shakur and James Belushi are two corrupt police detectives caught in a dangerous web of deceit in this gritty, smart and tough action thriller.
